definitions: Each point is candidate_utility minus previous_best_utility from the admission journal. Zero means score equality, not an independent performance threshold. Marker categories use the logged accepted flag, not a threshold inferred from rounded values. All 20 consecutive matched complete rounds are included; no smoothing or outcome selection.
scope: Adaptive development-side adapter admission decisions, separate from strict program-incumbent events. No independent first-proposal, learning-gain, cross-model or serving comparison.
